title: capsella algida
intro: Capsella algida, commonly known as Alpine Bittershield or Arctic Pepper-cress, is a species of flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Capsella algida include its use as an expectorant to help relieve respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis, as well as its potential to aid in digestion and relieve stomach upset. The bioactive constituents of Capsella algida include glucosinolates, which are sulfur-containing compounds that have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
